hints.tr: Sıra: `git init`, `.gitignore`, `git add .`, commit, `git remote add origin`, `git push -u origin main`.
hints.en: The order: `git init`, `.gitignore`, `git add .`, commit, `git remote add origin`, `git push -u origin main`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
git init
echo "*.log" > .gitignore
git add .
git commit -m "Start the blog"
git remote add origin https://github.com/ada/blog.git
git push -u origin main
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
git init
echo "*.log" > .gitignore
git add .
git commit -m "Start the blog"
git remote add origin https://github.com/ada/blog.git
git push -u origin main
```

label.tr: Start the blog commit'i, log izlenmiyor
label.en: Start the blog committed, the log untracked
